subject.title: [Bug] Gateway swallows user-visible reply when an agent's exec stdout matches "configuration file" — replies=2 puts ⚠️ 🛠️ first, the actual reply second

question: For successful agent turns with retained exec-like `lastToolError`, should OpenClaw suppress warnings after a visible reply, keep warnings but render answer-first, or suppress only proven false/recovered read-only exec cases?
rationale: Current main already fixes the Feishu ordering symptom, but broad core suppression was rejected in related discussion and the remaining behavior is a user-facing warning policy choice rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Narrow False/Recovered Exec Warning Fix
options.body: Preserve real mutating-tool warnings, but clear or suppress warnings when trajectory evidence proves the exec result was successful, read-only, or recovered before the final reply.

options.title: Treat Feishu Coalescing As Sufficient
options.body: Accept v2026.6.11 behavior once live proof shows the answer remains visible, leaving extra warnings after the answer as intentional diagnostics.

options.title: Broaden Core Exec Suppression
options.body: Suppress exec-like warning finals after successful assistant replies across channels, accepting that some valid diagnostics may become less visible.

recommendation.title: Narrow False/Recovered Exec Warning Fix
recommendation.body: Preserve real mutating-tool warnings, but clear or suppress warnings when trajectory evidence proves the exec result was successful, read-only, or recovered before the final reply.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the landed Feishu fix and has already weighed in on the related core-versus-channel warning boundary.
